items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: I just knew them here... See, there goes old Lloyd Teo.

ctx.x: I believe there's one relative somebody told me about.

And they may be able to give you. Something about their life. About their life. I just knew them here. And you see that old fellow going along. He was somewhat humbucked. It's him going along with he had an old-time clown in his case. He'd go along with his clown in his case and so forth. He used to hang it around his shoulder. See, there goes old Lloyd Teo. No one ever knew what was that. It was really in his brain.
There was a lot of music up there.
